Use Microsoft-Decision-1 on Microsoft Foundry

decider_foundry.Rd

Makes a decider for a deployment of Microsoft-Decision-1 on Microsoft Foundry (SystemOne format).

Usage

decider_foundry(
  endpoint = Sys.getenv("AZURE_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT"),
  deployment,
  credentials = NULL,
  input = NULL
)

Arguments

endpoint

The endpoint of the Foundry resource, for example "https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com". The default reads the environment variable AZURE_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT.

deployment

The name of the deployment. It is the model name of the request.

credentials

A function with no arguments that returns the key. NULL (the default) reads the environment variable AZURE_FOUNDRY_API_KEY each time decide() sends requests.

input

The input type that the model reads: "text", "image" or "text+image". NULL (the default) takes it from the internal table of input types; a model that is not in the table is not checked. decide() stops before any request when an input does not fit.

Value

A decider object for decide(). It holds no key.

Details

The requests go to <endpoint>/providers/microsoft/v1/systemone with the key in the api-key header. This release takes an API key only: a Microsoft Entra ID token, which goes in an Authorization header, does not work. This decider is not yet tested with a live call. Microsoft-Decision-1 reads text only.

Examples

decider_foundry("https://my-resource.services.ai.azure.com", "decision-1")
#> <decider> Microsoft Foundry
#> * Model: decision-1
#> * URL: https://my-resource.services.ai.azure.com/providers/microsoft/v1/systemone
#> * Request format: systemone
#> * Input: text
